name: Multi-GPU
author: Baptistus
description: Experimental multi-GPU support for WanGP v18.17+: a second GPU shares MiniMax H3 renders (denoising by sequence parallelism, VAE decoding, text encoder) and LTX-2 renders (2.3 and 2.5: denoising, VAE decoding), with adjustable work shares. Adds a 'Multi-GPU' tab to the Media Generator advanced settings.
